headline: Türkiye R&D spending rises to 980 billion liras in 2025
summary: Gross domestic expenditure on research and development in Türkiye grew by 328.6 billion Turkish Liras in 2025 to reach 980.4 billion liras, according to official statistics.
why: R&D expenditure is a key metric tracking a national economy's transition toward higher-value industrial production and technical innovation.
